responses.text: Ah, you return to me a King yourself! It would be an honor for me to do your hair! That is why you are here, yes?
Ah, I knew you'd be back. Ready for your entire life to change?
You want your hair done, too? No, no, no. The Kings are many, and their hair must be *perfect*.
Wonderful. Then let's begin making a whole new you!
You wound me! You simply must let me have a go at that hair sometime! Anything you can imagine, I can style!
